CA.rationale: Content (red coordinate) is explicitly paired with a processing origin for the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinate) and its organization/access origin are separately present for the same current referent, enabling content/status/organization differentiation.

A.rationale: A processing/origin label (command_estimate) is explicitly tied to the same candidate content (red coordinate), linking processing condition to content organization/access.

C.rationale: Report identifies represented content as coordinate sets with color attributes (red/blue) for specific referents/times.

D.rationale: Content identity (red coordinate) is presented alongside a separate organization/access status (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The origin/represented_time fields describe how the content is organized/presented/accessed for the current referent.
